notes: Tickets now supports multiple tabs. Every reply starts with a guaranteed greeting. Added automatic 30-day ticket expiry (Settings → Support, off by default) with an apologetic email. Moderation actions are now also logged locally so history can never come up empty for anything done through Overlord.
